dataPolicy.subtitle: Cómo se obtienen, verifican y actualizan los datos de esta plataforma.
dataPolicy.modelInfo: La información de los modelos (nombre, contexto, fecha de lanzamiento) se compila de la documentación oficial de los proveedores y se mantiene manualmente.
dataPolicy.pricing: Los precios provienen de páginas oficiales; el historial queda registrado.
dataPolicy.benchmark: Las puntuaciones de benchmark son actualmente datos de demostración/manuales (dataset: internal-demo) y se marcan como no verificadas hasta sustituirlas por resultados oficiales.
dataPolicy.ranking: El ranking se calcula de forma transparente a partir de benchmarks, capacidades, precio y contexto.
dataPolicy.verified: verificado — comprobado manualmente contra la fuente oficial.
dataPolicy.unverified: no verificado — aún no comprobado; tratar con cautela.
dataPolicy.updatePricing: Precios y modelos: manual/API, ante cambios.
dataPolicy.transparencyText: Nos comprometemos con la transparencia: cada cifra puede rastrearse a su fuente y estado. Los datos de demostración nunca se presentan como verificados. Este proyecto es gratuito, abierto y no comercial.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.bestModel.q: What is the best AI model?
faq.bestModel.a: Based on our transparent scoring, {name} currently leads with an overall score of {score} out of 100. Scores combine public benchmarks, capability, price efficiency, and context window, and are updated daily.
faq.howRanked.a: Models are scored on a transparent 0-100 formula: public benchmarks (50%), capabilities (20%), price efficiency (20%), and context window (10%). Rankings are snapshotted daily; the full methodology is documented on the ranking page.
faq.priceUpdate.a: Prices are sourced from official provider pricing and refreshed on a regular schedule, with price history tracked per model. The last update date is shown on each model page.
faq.benchmarkSource.q: Where does benchmark data come from?
faq.benchmarkSource.a: Benchmark results come from public sources (e.g. MMLU, GPQA, HumanEval, AIME) with dataset, version, and test date attributed on each entry. Note that some entries are community-submitted and unverified, as marked.
faq.modelContext.a: {name} supports a context window of {context} tokens.
faq.modelCost.a: {name} costs ${in} per 1M input tokens and ${out} per 1M output tokens.
faq.compareBetter.a: Based on overall scores, {winner} ranks higher ({sa} vs {sb}). See the comparison table for a full breakdown.
faq.compareCheaper.a: {cheaper} is cheaper: ${pa} vs ${pb} per 1M input tokens.
faq.compareCapability.q: What are the capability differences between {a} and {b}?
faq.compareBetter.aNone: No overall ranking data is available for {a} and {b}.
faq.compareCheaper.aNone: Price data is not available for {a} or {b}.
faq.compareCapability.aNone: {a} and {b} support the same set of capabilities.
landing.empty: No models available for this category yet.
landing.faq.bestFor.q: What is the best model for {case}?
landing.faq.bestFor.a: Based on our data, {name} ranks first for {case} with a score of {score}.
landing.faq.howSelected.a: Models are ranked by scenario-specific data: benchmark scores (coding/reasoning/math/vision), capability support, context window, or price. All data comes from our transparent model catalog, updated daily.
landing.faq.dataFresh.a: Model data, prices, and rankings are refreshed on a regular schedule; ranking scores are snapshotted daily. Each model page shows its last verified date.

data.sources.title: Data Sources
data.sources.desc: Every data point on this platform traces back to a documented source. Sources are graded by trust level: Official (100), Authoritative Benchmark (90), Community (70), Manual (40).
data.changelog.title: Data Changelog
data.changelog.desc: A public, timestamped record of every production data change: price updates, benchmark updates, and model updates.
data.methodology.title: Data Methodology
data.methodology.desc: How ranking, trust scores, and validation work — fully transparent.
data.changelog.empty: No data changes recorded yet. Changes appear here after verification.
data.methodology.rankingFormulaDesc: Raw = Benchmark 50% + Capability 20% + Price 20% + Context 10%; Overall = Raw x Data Confidence.
data.methodology.trustScoreDesc: Trust = Source Authority x Freshness x Completeness x Cross Validation x Version Reliability (0-100).
data.methodology.validationDesc: Pricing and benchmark data are cross-validated against official sources. Status: verified / warning / conflict / expired. Unverified data never enters production ranking.
data.methodology.sourcesDesc: No unknown data, no mock data. Every entry requires source + timestamp + confidence. Auto-discovery produces pending events that require approval.
data.authority.title: AI Model Data Authority
data.authority.desc: How we source, verify, and maintain model data — a fully auditable data infrastructure for AI models.
data.authority.sourcesDesc: Every data point traces to a documented source with trust level.
data.authority.validationDesc: Discovery produces pending events; cross-validation against official sources; approval before production. Unverified data never enters ranking.
data.authority.benchmarkDesc: Benchmark Trust v4 = Source Authority x Dataset Transparency x Reproducibility x Freshness x Cross Validation. Every result requires dataset, version, and source.
data.authority.rankingDesc: Raw = Benchmark 50% + Capability 20% + Price 20% + Context 10%; Overall = Raw x Data Confidence.
